items.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I played with Roy in 1925. He and his brother Joe had an orchestra in Pittsburgh... I had occasion to play with them once or twice.

ctx.x: One more artist who we just mentioned in passing, but maybe you can elaborate on a bit more, is Roy Eldridge.

Oh, Roy, I played with Roy in 1925. He and his brother Joe had an orchestra in Pittsburgh called the Elyte [phonetic] or Elite Serenaders. I had occasion to play with them once or twice. But he was an original.
